metadata.description: Calls the real preview-screenshot RPC and proves that a 390x844 request keeps its CSS viewport width.
metadata.name: Preview Screenshot Viewport

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/browser_automation_studio.v1.ai.AIService/TakePreviewScreenshot', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ url: window.location.origin, viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }) }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('preview-screenshot RPC failed: ' + response.status); const payload = await response.json(); if (payload.viewportWidth !== 390) throw new Error('preview-screenshot viewport width = ' + payload.viewportWidth + ', want 390'); return payload.viewportWidth; })()
